title: Original-publisher MD5 seeds joined to public computed-file identity metadata
scope: Four provider-reported MD5/SHA1/SHA256/size bridges. No local sample bytes acquired or rehashed. Analysis times are not campaign dates. Certipy remains legitimate supporting context.
